requirements.quote:
At the parental side of a
   zone cut (that is, at a delegation point), NSEC RRs are REQUIRED at
   the owner name.
requirements.condition: At the parental side of a zone cut (a delegation point).
requirements.required_behavior: NSEC RRs are required at the owner name of the delegation point.
requirements.why_checkable: The parent-zone data at a delegation owner name can be checked for the required NSEC records.

requirements.quote:
At the parental side of a
   zone cut (that is, at a delegation point), NSEC RRs are REQUIRED at
   the owner name.  A DS RR could also be present if the zone being
   delegated is signed and seeks to have a chain of authentication to
   the parent zone.
requirements.condition: At the parental side of a zone cut, when the delegated zone is signed and seeks a chain of authentication to the parent zone.
requirements.required_behavior: A DS RR may be present; its presence is permitted by this clause.
requirements.why_checkable: The permitted placement of a DS RR at a delegation point can be checked in zone-data handling without requiring every delegation to contain one.

requirements.quote:
This specification updates the original DNS specification to allow
   NSEC and DS RR types at the parent side of a zone cut.  These RRsets
   are authoritative for the parent when they appear at the parent side
   of a zone cut.
requirements.condition: An NSEC RRset appears at the parent side of a zone cut.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the NSEC RRset as authoritative for the parent zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The authority assigned to an NSEC RRset at a delegation point can be inspected in parent-zone data handling.

requirements.quote:
This specification updates the original DNS specification to allow
   NSEC and DS RR types at the parent side of a zone cut.  These RRsets
   are authoritative for the parent when they appear at the parent side
   of a zone cut.
requirements.condition: A DS RRset appears at the parent side of a zone cut.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the DS RRset as authoritative for the parent zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The authority assigned to a DS RRset at a delegation point can be inspected in parent-zone data handling.
